title: Kissed by Midnight Japanese Chicken Shoyu Ramen
description: A creamy, slightly spicy, and savory Japanese-inspired ramen dish, perfect for satisfying your midnight cravings. This paleo-friendly recipe combines the rich flavors of shoyu, chicken, and vegetables.

ingredients.name: coconut aminos
ingredients.notes: or regular soy sauce if not paleo

instructions: In a large pot, heat 1 tablespoon of chicken fat or coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the crushed red chili peppers and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the paleo chicken bones or wings and cook for 5 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add the shoyu ramen broth, paleo soy sauce, and coconut aminos. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken breast to the pot and cook for 5-7 minutes, until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pot and let it rest for a few minutes.
Add the chopped green onions and spinach leaves to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until wilted.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips and add it back to the pot.
Season the broth with additional soy sauce or coconut aminos if desired.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the ramen hot, garnished with additional green onions and spinach if desired.
